reviews_5s: Ordered as a gift. Perfect. OXO products are the best.Good to go!Great kitchen tool, well built, should last many yearsPerfect size and addition to my kitchenPerfect size. Not too big nor too small. I purchased it to make homemade ricotta.I love this tool. I use it almost daily. It is very fine and sturdy.Well made. Heavy. Very useful.I have never used one of these before and wish I had bought it sooner! You can scoop a lot out with this very quickly. The quality seems to be very good.I’ve seen many of these that are made in China, and they look like they’re not a good investment. This OXO spider is 5-1/2” wide, made from very sturdy chrome-plated steel and a nice rubber handle. It’s perfect for making hard boiled eggs, as it will hold 4 or 5 eggs at a time. Looks like it will last a lifetime and worth a few extra bucks rather than the cheap-quality ones!Durable kitchen item you need for draining many foods, not just pasta. Easy to use and easy to clean.
